interpretation: Exploratory surface-slope risk proxy, independent of measured radar return. Fixed primary threshold and sensitivity settings before elevation inspection; none is a calibrated SAR artifact threshold.
limitations: Surface model includes vegetation and structures; not surveyed bare earth or confirmed 2023 surface condition
30m derivative grid mapped by nearest neighbor to the radar grid does not create 20m elevation detail
Neighborhood maximum slope excludes steep or unknown support, but does not establish radar illumination, local incidence, layover, nonlocal shadow or processor stability
No threshold is selected from observed radar changes, crop outcomes or this sensitivity analysis
Radar stays separate from optical values and ineligible for agricultural ranking; no cause, irrigation, crop-loss or supervised-model claim
